profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. describes itself as the premier provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide. Its website markets GPU servers for modern data centers and AI systems featuring multi-GPU and interconnect technologies, along with short-depth and small form factor systems for compute, AI, and connectivity at the network edge.

The company is a for-profit public company with ticker SMCI, headquartered in San Jose, CA, and CIK number 0001375365. It also appears under the aliases Super Micro Computer, Inc. and SUPER MICRO COMPUTER INC. Public records show 281 California law exposure entries for the company.
